### ① Derived judgments

1. **`ConsoleChatbotFab` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, rendered by the published `ConsoleLayout` and `HomeLayout`) now goes `invisible` while any element matching `[data-fab-yield]` overlaps its own box** — RIGHT. Positional (box overlap, zero-size boxes excluded), not presence; re-measured at most once per frame on captured scroll, resize and childList mutations; `visibility: hidden` keeps the button's geometry so the measurement is stable, takes it out of hit-testing and the tab order, and the dock stays reachable from the top bar and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+I. Not a reversal of ADR-0057's decision that the FAB is the dock's collapsed affordance — it remains that everywhere the corner is free. Known narrowness, recorded not faulted: a layout shift with no scroll, resize or node add/remove (an attribute-only toggle) is not re-measured until the next of those.
2. **`InlineEditSaveBar` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`, a published export) renders `data-fab-yield=""` on its bar** — RIGHT as the mechanism, and the one public-surface change the FAB fix implies. Classification: a **published contract**, thin but real, not an informal convention — it crosses two independently published packages with no shared symbol, the FAB honours it on ANY element (a host can opt its own chrome in), and the changeset body advertises it to hosts ("which a host's floating launcher can read"). Additive and opt-in; removing it later would be a breaking change. Not a prop, not an export, not a setting, not a spec key — the claim's prohibitions hold.
3. **`RecordAttachmentsPanel` marks its Download and Delete row actions** — RIGHT; writer and reader are the same package; the Download marker is clear of the FAB at the measured geometry and is harmless.
4. **Attachment delete asks first through `ActionConfirmDialog`** — RIGHT and exactly the triage rule: the console's ordinary destructive confirm (the record page's own, objectui#11001), mounted with the same promise-based state, `destructive: true`, title the existing `detail.deleteAttachment`, confirm label the existing `objectActions.deleteConfirmButton`; `ActionConfirmDialog.tsx` is not in the file list. Cancel, Escape and overlay dismiss all route through the dialog's own `handleCancel`, which settles `false` — no dangling promise, nothing sent. Reaches every mount of the panel (RecordDetailView, the synthesized Attachments tab, the `record:attachments` SDUI block). ⛔ No new setting — none in the diff.
5. **One new pack key `detail.deleteAttachmentConfirm`, interpolating the file name (the placeholder spelled NAME), in all ten packs** — RIGHT; the no-fit claim verified on `main`: `detail.deleteConfirmation` and `objectActions.deleteConfirm` both say "this record", and `removeAttachment` is a label, not a question. `TranslationKeys` derives from `en`, so the published key type widens.
6. **Pins** — RIGHT: the yield pin stubs `getBoundingClientRect` by role and accessible label (never by the marker) with the Playwright-measured boxes, and carries a shown-before and shown-after control on the same mount plus a phone-geometry positional control; the confirm pin uses the real `alertdialog`, reads strings by key in en and zh, asserts nothing is deleted while the dialog is open, cancel deletes nothing, confirm deletes exactly once with `sys_attachment` and `a2`; the three existing delete-path pins now answer the dialog; the de quote-pairing counts move 84 to 85 with the reason written beside them. Four ablation legs reported red as expected.
7. **No accept-set narrowing anywhere**: no prop, export, route, spec key or setting is removed or narrowed.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/12248-fab-yields-attachment-confirm.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` minor; the body names the marker, the confirm and the key; no `major` (objectui AGENTS.md §9 版本号策略 holds; Changeset Bump Policy green). `Clause-②: yes` on the PR body (line-initial, no arm — read as a declared widening by `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`) and on the claim — TRUTHFUL: the diff widens `@object-ui/i18n`'s key set, and under ① item 2 it also widens `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s rendered surface and the FAB's accept-set in `@object-ui/app-shell`. The `minor` on i18n is the right level and carries the group.

Finding, not blocking: by the classification above, `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (and on `@object-ui/app-shell`) understates an additive widening by one notch — `minor` is the truthful word for both. Effect on what publishes: none — all 40 packages sit in one `fixed` group, so the i18n `minor` already lifts every package to the same minor version; the only artefact is the CHANGELOG section heading under which the entry prints. objectui's own policy subordinates per-package level purity to the group convention (it marks even breaking changes `minor`), so this is noted for the owning seat to correct if the branch is pushed again, and it does not fail the head.
